description: SOUND DESIGN for a film, from a PLAN of its sound: beds (a place's sound per scene — near and far) and events (each one a STACK of layers by its kind: an impact = hit + lead-in + debris + weight; a whoosh = body + speed + character; footsteps; a riser…), every sound named in a sound library's words (3–6 plain words: source, material, action). TWO CALLS: (1) {video_key, plan} → asks: the sounds the plan needs, each once — make each with doseedo_generate_sound {prompt, kind, duration_seconds} — its prompt, never its ask (10 credits a sound); (2) the same {video_key, plan} + sounds: [{ask, audio_url}] → the plan's times snapped onto the picture (its cuts, in-shot impacts and movements), every layer placed, levelled, panned, in its room, and the SESSION: lanes[] = the FX bus's tracks, one per type of sound (Ambience, Footsteps, Impacts, Whooshes, Risers…) and, where a type is layered, one per layer ("Impacts · hit", "Impacts · debris"), each a file over the whole film (url) with its regions [{start_s, end_s}] and the fader it plays at (gain_db); mix_url = the whole design as one stem — lay it on the film with doseedo_score_to_picture tracks [{audio_url: mix_url, start_s: 0, role: "effects"}], and hand the lanes over as the session's tracks (a film of sound design alone: its download is the printmaster and these, never the silent score). A sound that is not sent is left out and listed (report.missing). CPU, no credits. Async: job_id → doseedo_wait_task (the first call ~1 s, the second ~20–90 s: it reads every frame). Cancel: a sound design still queued never starts and one running stops within seconds; either way its credit is refunded and the job ends as canceled.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

loudness.description: The design's level: "alone" (-18 LUFS, default: the film's only sound), "under_music" (-24: under a score), or a LUFS number.

name.description: Optional: a name for this job's files, e.g. "rainy-loop-3". Every file it returns downloads as <name>_<part>.<ext> (rainy-loop-3_Celesta.wav, rainy-loop-3_rough-mix.wav; one take: rainy-loop-3.wav), so the user can find them. Give each job its own name (a second take: "rainy-loop-3b"). Default: doseedo-<last 6 characters of the job id>.

plan.description: The sound of the film: {beds: [{from, to, near, far?, level?: low|mid|high, fade_in?, fade_out?}], events: [{at, kind, size?: 1|2|3, what, pan?: -1..1, layers?: {<layer>: words}} | {kind: "steps", from, to, people?: 1-4, what}]} — seconds on the film; kind = whoosh | pass | impact | mechanism | hard | accent | ui | group | creature | rise | steps.

sounds.description: The second call: each ask the first call returned, with the sound made for it — [{ask, audio_url}] (a doseedo_generate_sound file URL as returned).

video_key.description: R2 ingest key of the film (the upload doseedo_spot_video read).

video_url.description: https URL of the film, as an alternative to video_key.

name: doseedo_sound_design
title: Sound design to picture
